results.name: Character Scan Photogrammetry
results.description:
A project I worked on get a person scanned as best as possible with a Phone's camera, nothing more.
The textures are lower resolution for sketchfab. I managed to capture a lot of detail for a simple phone camera but there is always room for improvement.

Due to the still low light environment, there were very dark shadows in the resulting textures/scan. But thanks to the decent amount of data being captured by my phone, I could photoshop it to the point of having no light source.

I'll be giving it another try to get beter image quality, resulting in more accurate and high quality scans. Followed by a better remeshing phase to get a more clean wireframe than this disaster.

Thanks to Mathias Defoer for being my subject.
